name: ai.overwing/mcp
title: Overwing
description: Guardrails for LLM output: pass / fail / review verdicts and one recommended action. Hosted or npm.

environmentVariables.name: OVERWING_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Overwing organization key (ow_live_...). Optional: evaluate and atlas_lookup work without it, 10 a day each. Needed for higher limits, rule sets and Tower setup. Get one at https://overwing.ai/login or POST https://overwing.ai/api/v1/signup

environmentVariables.name: OVERWING_AGENT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Overwing Tower agent key (ow_agent_...). Without it, the tower_create_agent tool mints one for the session

environmentVariables.name: OVERWING_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL for self-hosted deployments (default https://overwing.ai)

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. "Bearer ow_live_..." lifts the free limits; evaluate and atlas_lookup work without it, 10 a day each
